name: Kling AI Global Plugin
tagline: Generate images and videos through Kling AI Global MCP
description: Official Kling AI Global remote MCP with browser OAuth. Generation uses credits from the authorized Global account; Global and China accounts, credits, and tasks are separate. For the official npm plugin bundle and standalone CLI, see https://www.npmjs.com/package/@klingai/plugin-global and https://www.npmjs.com/package/@klingai/cli-global. Setup guide: https://kling.ai/app/mcp/guide. Kling Image 4.0 is live in Kling Creative Studio and via API; MCP model availability must be checked in the live tool discovery.

install.notes: Authenticate with a Kling Global account. Image or video generation consumes that account's credits.
